column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for individual fan-idol interaction activity session. PK = Interactions(Activity_Reg).
TIMESTAMP. Precise timestamp when the interaction activity occurred.
TEXT. Reference to the fan user participating in this interaction. FK to Fans.
TEXT. Reference to the virtual_idol idol involved in this interaction. FK to virtualidols.

TEXT. Type of interaction activity performed. **NULL means interaction type classification failed or is ambiguous.** **DATA NOISE: Values have random case variations (lowercase, uppercase, mixed case) virtual_idol.**

TEXT. Platform where the interaction took place. **NULL means platform identification failed or cross-platform activity.** **DATA NOISE: Values have random case variations (lowercase, uppercase, mixed case) virtual_idol.**

TEXT. Specific platform or service used for the interaction. **NULL means platform usage tracking incomplete or privacy mode enabled.** **DATA NOISE: Values have random case variations (lowercase, uppercase, mixed case) virtual_idol.**

TEXT. Device type used by fan for the interaction. **NULL means device detection failed or privacy settings block tracking.** **DATA NOISE: Values have random case variations (lowercase, uppercase, mixed case) virtual_idol.**
TEXT. Application version used during the interaction session.
SMALLINT. Duration of the interaction session in minutes.
SMALLINT. Number of live stream sessions attended during this interaction.
REAL. Total hours of content watched during the interaction session.
